selection: Depth-first investigation of three restaurants from the initial discovery inventory. Esme was selected twice before discovery results reached the parent; subsequent scouts had explicit Rintaro and Flour + Water assignments. Parent audited one previously available Esme date.
collector: agent-browser; resy-listed-pilot, resy-rintaro, resy-flour-water, and parent resy-audit-20260930
procedure: Each scout loaded agent-browser skills get core, checked actual UTC/SF clocks, and derived its own session with agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix <assignment>.

Open each canonical Resy URL with ?date=2026-10-01&seats=2. Wait for the venue heading and inspect snapshot -i -u. Verify #party_size=2, #DropdownGroup__selector--date--selection=Tomorrow, and #time=All Day.

Wait for .ShiftInventory__availability-message or button.ReservationButton. Inspect agent-browser network requests when inventory does not render. OPTIONS requests to /4/find and /4/venue/calendar returned HTTP 500; corresponding inventory requests had no successful response status.

Esme scout used doctor --offline --quick once, verified the selected October 1 calendar label, and stopped inventory collection. Follow the Resy-linked official site, expand Reservations and Hours, and wait for aria-expanded=true before reading policy text.

Rintaro scout inspected network requests, errors, console, and read-only DOM/performance resource status once. Follow the Resy-linked official site and read #location for address, service hours, and the 28-day release policy. No inventory retry.

Flour + Water scout's inventory-specific wait timed out after 25 seconds. Inspect network requests --filter api.resy.com/4, errors, and console once. Follow the official homepage's FAQ and expand the reservation-policy heading to verify release text.

Parent audited Esme October 8 in a separate named session, checking the actual two-guest/date controls. The inventory wait timed out. doctor --offline --quick passed; network requests showed both inventory preflights returning 500. No retry or workaround.

Record collection_error, not unavailable, for failed dates. Leave unexamined dates omitted. Close only each owned session. Stop expansion after the shared inventory-loading failure was corroborated across venues and sessions.
limitations: Venue metadata and official restaurant pages loaded, but inventory preflights failed. No scarcity inference is justified from these failures.
Esme has two failed date observations; Rintaro and Flour + Water each have one. Other dining dates in this collection were not queried.
Rintaro and Flour + Water publish 28-day release policies but do not explicitly state the release timezone. No unavailable status was inferred from the policies alone.
Published recurring hours do not establish holiday-specific exceptions.
No login, reservation, checkout, API replay, challenge bypass, or speculative retry. This is an incomplete convenience subset, not a citywide ranking.
